answer.answer:
Three firms appear in more than one joint development partnership in the records in front of me: Firm_060 in three, and Firm_061 and Firm_082 in two each. Firm_060 is the most recurrent partner, tied to two different partner groupings, and its largest partnership is the one behind an actual deployed process record. Every other firm here appears in a single partnership only. These counts hold for the eight partnership records retrieved, not for the whole census, and the records describe joint development of construction robots rather than "co-developed processes" as such.

**Firm_060, three partnerships.** Firm_168, Firm_060, Firm_008, Firm_009 and Firm_064 jointly developed the robot recorded as census_RXM6-4 [1], and that record is the census record of a deployed process, RP14. Within it the roles differ: Firm_060, Firm_008 and Firm_168 are the manufacturers, while Firm_009 and Firm_064 are distributors, so the five-way partnership is not five firms doing the same thing. Firm_060 then appears twice more with a different core group: with Firm_061 and Firm_079 on census_RXM6-7 [2], a steel-material record, and with Firm_061 alone on census_RXM6-6 [3], also steel. That gives Firm_060 a stable bilateral relationship with Firm_061 plus a wider consortium.

**Firm_061, two partnerships.** Both are with Firm_060, on census_RXM6-7 and census_RXM6-6, both carrying steel as the worked material.

**Firm_082, two partnerships.** With Firm_072 on census_RXM8-3 [4] and with Firm_003 on census_RXM8-1 [5]. In both cases Firm_082 is listed as a manufacturer alongside its partner, and the partner differs between the two, so Firm_082 is a repeat collaborator rather than one half of a fixed pair.

**Single-appearance partnerships.** The remaining records each involve firms that appear once in this retrieval: a seven-firm grouping of Firm_177, Firm_002, Firm_018, Firm_068, Firm_094, Firm_134 and Firm_209 on census_RXM23-5 [6], the largest consortium here, all seven recorded as manufacturers; Firm_097 with Firm_098 on census_RXH8-2 [7], a timber record; and Firm_027, Firm_028 and Firm_033 on census_RXH5-4 [8], which is recorded through developedBy rather than hasManufacturer, a different relation from the others and worth noting if you are treating development role and manufacturing role as equivalent.

**What this does not establish.** The eight partnership records are a retrieved selection, not a closed set, so a firm appearing once here may well appear in further partnerships elsewhere in the census. Only census_RXM6-4 is linked to a deployed process record (RP14); the other seven carry no such link in the material available, which means I cannot say whether they reached deployment. The context also carries no enabler activations for any of these census records, so nothing here supports a claim about which capabilities or preconditions these co-developed robots draw on.
